content: प्रथम [प्रथ्-अमच्] (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab> {%m.%} प्रथमे or प्रथमाः) .²1 First, foremost; मखांशभाजां प्रथमो मनीषिभिस्त्वमेव देवेन्द्र सदा निगद्यसे <ls>R. 3. 44</ls>; <ls>H. 2. 39</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 44</ls>. .²2 First, chief, principal, most excellent or eminent, matchless, incomparable; <ls>Śi. 15. 42</ls>; एष वै प्रथमः कल्पः प्रदाने हव्यकव्ययोः <ls>Ms. 3. 147</ls>. .²3 Earliest, most ancient, primary. .²4 Prior, previous, former, earlier; प्रथमसुकृतापेक्षया <ls>Me. 17</ls>; नामधेयं गुरुश्चक्रे जगत्प्रथममङ्गलम् <ls>R. 10. 67</ls>. .²5 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The first person (= third person according to European phraseology). .{@-मः@} .²1 The first (third) person. .²2 The first consonant of a class. .²3 (In <ab>math.</ab>) The sum of the products divided by the difference between the squares of the cosine of the azimuth and the sine of the amplitude. .{@-मा@} The nominative case. .{@-मम्@} {%ind.%} .²1 first, firstly, at first; उमास्तनोद्भेदमनुप्रवृद्धो मनोरथो यः प्रथमं बभूव <ls>Ku. 7. 24</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 4</ls>. .²2 Already, previously, formerly; प्रथमोदितम् aforesaid; तमभ्यनन्दत् प्रथमं प्रबोधितः प्रजेश्वरः शासनहारिणा हरेः <ls>R. 3. 68</ls>. .²3 At once, immediately. .²4 Before; यात्रायै चोदयामास तं शक्तेः प्रथमं शरत् <ls>R. 4. 24</ls>; उत्तिष्ठेत् प्रथमं चास्य चरमं चैव संविशेत् <ls>Ms. 2. 194</ls>. .²5 Newly, recently. प्रथमम्--अनन्तरम् or ततः or पश्रात् first, afterwards; प्रथमात् firstly, for the first time; प्रथमतः .²1 At first, firstly. .²2 previously. .²3 immediately. .²4 before, in preference to (<ab>gen.</ab>)
